Tucker의 "Views"는 바닥을 뚫고 떨어졌으며 더욱 악화될 것입니다. 그가 완전히 무의미해지고 놀랍게도 매우 낮은 I.Q가 되었다는 점에서 누구도 더 이상 그를 신경 쓰지 않습니다. 개인. 그는 대학을 간신히 졸업할 수 있었고 어쩌면 그렇지 않았을 수도 있습니다. 하지만 정말 멍청한 사람들만이 인생에서 그 멋진 4년의 시간을 이겨낼 수 없습니다! 터커는 공직에 출마하고 싶어하지만 인지 테스트를 받아야 합니다. 그에게는 기회가 없지만 공화당 표가 무엇이든 간에 아마도 몇 가지 포인트를 앗아갈 수 있을 것입니다! 터커는 패배자이며 항상 그랬습니다! 매우 신경증적인 젊은 여성인 마조리 테일러 브라운(그린은 스트레스를 받으면 브라운으로 변합니다!)은 몇 주 만에 극도의 보수주의자에서 자유주의적인 "바보"로 변했습니다.
items.ti_en: Tucker Carlson just met with Lightweight “Former” Congressman, Thomas Massie, and Marjorie “Traitor” Greene, LOSERS ALL! Tucker’s “Views” have fallen through the floor, and will only get worse. Nobody cares about him any longer in that he has become totally irrelevant, and happens to be, surprisingly, a very Low I.Q. individual. He could barely get out of College, and maybe he didn’t, but only really dumb people can’t make it through that wonderful four year time in life! Tucker wants to run for political office, but he should be required to take a cognitive test. He’s got no chance, but could probably take a couple of points away from whatever the Republican ticket happens to be! Tucker is a loser, and always has been! Marjorie Taylor Brown (Green turns to Brown under stress!), a highly neurotic young woman, went from Ultra Conservative to a Liberal “Fool,” all in a matter of weeks, because I refused to return her phone calls — Not because I didn’t like her, just because I had no time. She was way down in the Polls in Georgia (because I took away my Endorsement), and would have had no chance at winning, so she, just like everyone else, “QUIT!” Thomas Massie has turned out to be a failed politician, and a real JERK. He thought it was really wonderful to vote, “NO,” on everything, no matter how good, strong, or proper the Legislation would be. What a team this would be, THREE LOSERS, and a pocketful of change! The only chance they have is to join the Radical Left Dumocrats, and try breaking into the Primary System. To all of them I say, PRAISE BE TO ALLAH! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti_en: Today we brought another American home! Kevin Rideout, a brave Christian missionary, was held hostage by ISIS Jihadists for ten months! Welcome back home Kevin — It was an Honor to help you! President DONALD J. TRUMP
